svg.title: Sequencer
svg.desc: Benchtop DNA sequencer with sample bay, touchscreen run trace, status lights, vents, and reagent compartment. Biological basis: Benchtop sequencers combine fluidics, optical or electrical detection, temperature control, and run-control electronics.
